name: Women’s Wellness
headline: Support that adapts as your life changes.
summary: Support adaptation through changing life stages, stressors, priorities and needs.
description: Personalized coaching for women navigating changing needs, responsibilities, habits and life stages, without reducing the experience to symptoms or a prescribed routine. Whether you’re building sustainable routines, moving through pregnancy, postpartum, perimenopause or menopause, or carrying more than your share, coaching helps you adapt and make informed choices.
metaDescription: Women’s Wellness in Brighton and Howell, MI, or virtually: coaching for changing life stages, routines, stress and the choices that matter to you.
scopeNote: Women’s Wellness is coaching, not medical care: it does not diagnose or treat medical conditions. Where symptoms, medications or medical concerns are involved, diagnosis and treatment remain with qualified healthcare professionals.

value.heading: How we help
value.lead: Women’s Wellness at TAB starts with the whole person—not a checklist of symptoms, habits, or expectations.
paragraphs: Coaching is collaborative rather than prescriptive: we help you identify what matters, understand what may be getting in the way, and create strategies that fit your real life.

Needs shift through pregnancy, postpartum, perimenopause, menopause, caregiving years, and other transitions. Rather than treating those as problems to “fix,” coaching helps you adapt and make informed choices.

cards.title: Perimenopause and menopause
cards.body: Lifestyle support for energy, sleep, stress, movement, and routines through midlife change.

cards.title: Pregnancy and postpartum
cards.body: Practical, supportive habits for a demanding season, within appropriate scope.

cards.title: Caregiving and transitions
cards.body: Reconnect with your own needs when life has been about everyone else’s.

cards.title: Health advocacy
cards.body: Organize your questions, goals, and observations for conversations with your healthcare team.

cards.title: Routines that last
cards.body: Sustainable rhythms for movement, nourishment and recovery that fit your real life.

cards.title: Self-trust and agency
cards.body: Rebuild confidence in your own body, judgment and choices.

value.transform: Change patterns or routines that no longer fit.
value.adapt: Respond to changing life stages and circumstances.
value.balance: Recalibrate priorities, support, movement, recovery and self-care.
value.quote: Build the capacity to adapt as life and the body change.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.body: We start with your goals, routines, stressors, and stage of life.

steps.title: Your plan
steps.body: Practical, realistic next steps—built together, not handed to you.

steps.title: Check-ins
steps.body: Scheduled conversations plus support between sessions, virtual or in person.

items.q: Is coaching a replacement for my doctor?
items.a: No. Coaching works alongside your healthcare team. We focus on habits, routines, and practical change; diagnosis and treatment stay with licensed professionals.
Yes. Coaching is available virtually and in person.

items.q: What does a coaching engagement look like?
items.a: Most clients work with us over a defined period with scheduled sessions and support in between. We’ll recommend a structure that fits your goals.
